detail.longDescription:
EverAsk is the AI agent and assistant that does the work for you. Give it a task in plain words and it plans the steps, gets it done and hands you the finished result: a slide deck, a live website, a research report, a spreadsheet, an image or a video. It automates everyday tasks across your apps and keeps working while you're away.

DOES THE WORK, NOT JUST THE TALKING
Other AI apps stop at a reply. EverAsk breaks your request into clear steps, works through them one by one and delivers something you can use, share or publish.

AUTOMATES YOUR EVERYDAY TASKS
Connect Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Slack, Notion, Canva, Jira, Linear, GitHub, Stripe and 30+ more. EverAsk sorts your inbox, books meetings, prepares you for reviews and handles tasks across your apps from one request. AI automation with no workflows to build.

KEEPS WORKING WHILE YOU'RE AWAY
Your AI agent runs in the cloud. Start a big task, close the app and come back to the finished result. EverAsk shows you what is done, what is still running and what needs your OK.

YOU STAY IN CONTROL
• Turn on Ask Permission to approve actions before they run
• Set each connected app to Allow, Ask or Not allowed
• Stop any task at any time

SLIDES & PRESENTATIONS
• An AI presentation maker: one prompt, document or template becomes a complete deck
• Structure, design and content handled for you
• Present from your phone, export to PowerPoint, PDF or images, or share a link

WEBSITES
• An AI website builder: describe a website or web app and watch it get built
• Publish it to your own web address in a tap
• Add sign-ups, a database and file storage with no coding, and download the code any time

RESEARCH & REPORTS
• Your agent reads sources across the web and writes a structured report
• Every report comes with links you can check
• Choose Standard, Deep or Ultra Deep

DOCS, SHEETS & DATA
• Reports, proposals and letters, formatted and ready to send
• Spreadsheets and charts from raw data or a CSV file
• Resumes with an ATS score, and contracts you can sign

IMAGES, VIDEO & MUSIC
• Logos, posters, product shots and art from a text prompt
• Short videos, explainers and motion graphics
• UGC-style video ads and original music

QUICK ANSWERS, TOO
Need something fast? Get answers, write and rewrite, summarize PDFs and files (up to 20 at once), plan a trip, or speak instead of typing.

WHY EVERASK
• One personal assistant instead of five apps
• Big requests become clear steps, carried through to the end
• Projects, memory and history that follow you across devices

Hand EverAsk the work that fills your day and keep the parts only you can do.

FREE TO START
Download EverAsk free and start with Flash mode. Upgrade to Pro and Ultra for bigger, multi-step work and higher limits.
